# Ids of the ADMX template (packaging/policy/rustket.admx) that published
# GPOs and Intune configurations refer to: the policy names, the element
# ids (Intune's OMA-URI data), the category, the supportedOn definitions
# and the ADML string ids. A line is never removed or renamed.
#
# The ids are grouped by template revision, the R<n> of the namespace
# Rustket.Policies.R<n> (docs/policy.md section 14). A published section is
# never edited: keys added later go into a new "revision <n+1>" section
# with all their ids, and the generator's REVISION becomes n+1. Every key
# of a section was introduced in the same Rustket version.
revision 1
policy ManagedServers
policy AllowUserServers
policy AllowedServers
policy RequireHttps
policy AllowCertificateExceptions
policy UpdateMode
policy AllowPasswordLogin
policy AllowTokenLogin
policy AllowSecretsFile
policy NotificationPreview
policy HardwareAcceleration
policy LaunchAtLogin
policy OrganizationName
policy SupportUrl
policy MinimumVersion
element ManagedServers/ManagedServers
element AllowedServers/AllowedServers
element UpdateMode/UpdateMode
element OrganizationName/OrganizationName
element SupportUrl/SupportUrl
element MinimumVersion/MinimumVersion
category Rustket
supported SUPPORTED_Rustket_0_4_0
string SUPPORTED_Rustket_0_4_0
string Rustket
